notes.title: Patch Notes 1.6.4
notes.notes:
- Settings UI has been updated.

- Fixed the instant turning issue during the boss chase.

- Work on the online system has begun.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.6
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Cinematic scenes have been polished.

[*] Fixed an issue where some trees were consuming more RAM than intended.

[*] The female enemy AI is now smarter.

[*] Fixed a bug where items not added to the inventory would still remain visible on screen when picked up while being chased.
[/list]

The next update will focus on expanding the parameters of the settings interface.
Please remember that the game is still in Early Access, so if you encounter any issues that affect the gameplay experience, let us know in the comments. We'll continue improving based on your feedback.

NKARE GAMES
I.B

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.5
notes.notes:
- Quest information has been updated.

- After collecting items, the game now provides guidance on what to do next.

- The final chase sequence is now more action-packed.

- The female character's animations have been changed.

- Fixed an issue that caused the cross to disappear.

- Overall game flow has been improved.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.4
notes.notes:
- An object inspection system has been added to the game, and the texts on the objects have been explained.
- Optimization has been performed in specific areas of the map to improve game stability.
- A minor visual update has been made to the female enemy character.
- The female enemy character's entrance animation has been replaced with a newly created one.
- The major FPS drop issue in the boss character’s scene has been resolved.
- Minor changes have been made to the enemy encounter in the graveyard. :)
- t is now more clear which furnace items should be placed into.
- Climbing onto rocks on the map may no longer be as safe as before...
- The user interface has been clarified to provide a better experience for first-time players.
- When all 4 objects are collected, the chase sequence with all characters now starts properly!

NOTE: We would like to emphasize that our game is still in early access! The game will continue to be developed and will eventually reach the level it deserves. We sincerely thank all our early supporters who recognize its potential and wish you a great experience.
Remember: If an update hasn’t come in a while, that only means a huge patch is on its way!

notes.title: Small Patch Notes 1.3
notes.notes:
- Added Chinese, Japanese, and French language localizations to all in-game texts.

- A new event has been added to reintroduce the boss character into action after respawning in the final scene.

notes.title: Small Patch Notes: 1.2
notes.notes: - German and Russian localizations have been added.

notes.title: Small Patch Notes 1.1
notes.notes:
- Main menu UI has been adjusted.

- Turkish localization has been implemented.

- The issue that caused ground sounds to not be detected in-game has been fixed.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES:
notes.notes:
– Fixed the issue where events wouldn't trigger after collecting all 4 objects.
– The chase music in the final scene now fades out properly.
